issues.issue: Four visible folios depart from sequential PDF order
issues.disposition: Visible labels are preserved; cause of the anomaly is not established and prose is not reordered.

issues.issue: Good houses, moderate dignity and major testimonies have no complete numerical rule here
issues.disposition: Do not convert testimony inventory into probabilities or an automatic wealth verdict.

issues.issue: Conjunction/benefic alternatives have nonformal coordination
issues.disposition: Keep printed and/or distinctions; exact multi-planet Boolean grouping remains unresolved.

issues.issue: Near fixed stars lacks a complete local coordinate/tolerance specification
issues.disposition: Spica is given at Libra18 without minutes; do not insert zero minutes. Regulus has no exact coordinate in this span.

issues.issue: Aspect-source house or Moon lordship offers alternatives without a tie-breaker
issues.disposition: No new priority or independent-evidence count assigned between these alternatives.

issues.issue: How far sixth-house human-sign/occupancy conditions extend over later occupations
issues.disposition: Opening occupancy retained; later attachment remains explicit rather than silently broadened.

issues.issue: Ninth-house aquatic condition and later personal-intermediary alternatives
issues.disposition: Cancer/Pisces and lord therein preserved; the later alternatives' condition scope is not made certain.

issues.issue: Three significators, reception and listed houses in strongest continued-wealth rule
issues.disposition: No invented all-pairs relation, house override or numeric confidence.

issues.issue: Most afflicting planet has no complete severity/tie rule
issues.disposition: Obstructer selection cannot be optimized after the outcome.

issues.issue: Have reception of in the negative ordinary-party clause
issues.disposition: Keep direction unresolved where the source is less explicit; do not reverse clear receiving clauses elsewhere.

issues.issue: Scope of unimpeded/benefic conditions across superior-payment alternatives
issues.disposition: Preserve distinct lord and occupant clauses instead of pretending a unique parse.

issues.issue: Distance to perfection and actual time to moving contact differ
issues.disposition: Static degrees alone cannot yield an astronomical encounter or civil date.

issues.issue: Business duration may replace months with years without an objective threshold
issues.disposition: Separate timing profiles; no after-outcome choice of unit or universal degree/year rule.

issues.issue: His own houses and angular exception in the attributed ancient conjunction route
issues.disposition: Same sign at question is required; pronoun ownership and one/both planet scope remain unresolved.

issues.issue: Ascendant-distance route supplies no complete sign-to-unit table
issues.disposition: Movable/capable-of-days branch retained; no invented common/fixed months/years mapping.

issues.issue: Chart minute glyph read as 0 by root/XXVIII reader and as 6-like by XXVII checker
issues.disposition: Retain 0-versus-6 ambiguity; no calculation or calendar claim uses the chart time.

issues.issue: Compact final chart-centre aspect shorthand not fully secure
issues.disposition: Printed positions are retained, but the unresolved shorthand is not promoted as another rule.

issues.issue: Historical calendar, local time convention and modern UTC conversion unresolved
issues.disposition: No modern sky recomputation or parity claim.

issues.issue: Four swift planets in motion rows versus five in timing prose
issues.disposition: Both source readings preserved; count mismatch is not repaired in the witness.

issues.issue: Jupiter's qualitative afflictions are not numerical debits in the printed tally
issues.disposition: Retain the table and the separate affliction claims; no invented combined score.

issues.issue: Fortune admitted to second despite being 6 degrees25 minutes before its cusp
issues.disposition: No general replacement threshold follows; a strict universal five-degree rule is not admitted.

issues.issue: Exact antiscia criterion coexists with near Saturn contra-antiscion to Jupiter
issues.disposition: Computed residual is2 degrees50 minutes; no universal near cutoff is supplied.

issues.issue: Receives followed by neither receiving nor received in one sentence
issues.disposition: No silent emendation or runtime formalization; potentially different senses remain an interpretation.

issues.issue: Nested obstruction chains contain unclear pronouns or an omitted joining relation
issues.disposition: Record provisional editorial relation mapping, not a proven executable graph.

issues.issue: Ill-disposition list and cadency/non-beholding attachment
issues.disposition: No invented conjunction/disjunction over every item or additive score.

issues.issue: A planet in hard-aspect rejection lacks a fully explicit role in its first clause
issues.disposition: Keep the well-disposed-receiver exception and received-planet impediment distinct.

issues.issue: Impedited malefic in translation must be received again, but receiver unnamed
issues.disposition: Do not assign the receiving agent by convenience.

issues.issue: About-two-year and about1640 statements are not exact date formulas
issues.disposition: Printed distances reproduced without inventing event dates or precise forecast windows.

issues.issue: Reported outcomes do not document every endpoint or full lifetime
issues.disposition: One selected retrospective case; no independent accuracy rate, counterfactual success, or lifelong verification.

issues.issue: Two things in the closing caution lacks an unambiguous numbered pair
issues.disposition: Do not manufacture two independently confirmed warnings.

issues.issue: No complete rule combines net score, dignity, office, reception and fixed-sign testimony
issues.disposition: Positive/negative totals are not a complete engine and repeated roles are dependent.

issues.issue: Subtract-lesser-from-greater rule gives no tied-score interpretation
issues.disposition: Exact arithmetic is reproducible; zero-score semantic outcome remains unspecified.

notice: Open includes source discretion and evidence limits, not only transcription defects; these are not repaired by fitting the outcome.
